changelog: Fix: BacktestController::createSession() treated a blank Start Date the same as an out-of-range one, rejecting it with "Start date must fall within this symbol/timeframe's available history" even though nothing had actually been entered. Start Date is now genuinely optional -- an empty field starts the session at the earliest available candle for that symbol/timeframe (candle_sync's own earliest_open_time), and the range check only runs at all when a date is actually given.

New: get_backtest_symbol_range (BacktestController::getSymbolRange()) -- returns candle_sync's earliest/latest open_time for a symbol+timeframe pair. Needed because get_symbols' own earliest_candle_ms is symbol-level only (not scoped to a timeframe) and has no "latest" counterpart at all, so the setup form had no source for either a correct per-timeframe earliest date or a max bound.

The setup form's Start Date field now prefills to that earliest date whenever the symbol or timeframe changes (so the user sees exactly what they'll get by default before editing it), and its min/max are set to the real available range so an out-of-range date can't be picked in the browser's own date picker to begin with. The 'Data from ... onward' helper line is unchanged.
Label now reads "Start Date (optional -- defaults to the earliest available candle)" so the fixed behaviour is visible in the UI, not just in the error handling.
release_notes: No new migration in this release. Nothing was deployed or migrated as part of this turn, per instruction.
